Current primary M0 docs describe M0-operated shared infrastructure and public user swapIn/swapOut wrapping, distinct from partner extensions and issuer gateway.
September9 2026 M0 team launch article describes live PYUSDx platform and Saturn/Concrete/Cap partners; scale/backing claims are attributed marketing, not independently established by this admission.

sourceSemantics: Canonical M0 shared PYUSDx SwapFacility, not Saturn-only: the M0 primary deployment page identifies this exact Ethereum facility and M0 overview says M0 operates swap infrastructure and its transparent core proxies. Saturn USDat is one approved partner extension, not a second protocol counted here. This is not the legacy M-backed facility.

At RPC block 26256993, EIP1967 implementation slot resolves facility 0x0bc305e7e13113caed3f5486849e9518a1cc4173 to 0xc37370ba22f8c565f64fdb4d85314c14d6bb3b3f, agreeing with explorer current implementation and retained exact-match source/ABI. paused=false, pyusdx=0xebdb0942ce16386ab90718c7bd10c91cdb66b14d and extensionFactory=0x25c8affc5a63d8e047c12918c0438aba5aa09c2a. Proxy/admin, factory approvals and extensions can change; no persistent implementation or dependency attestation is provided.

swapIn(extensionOut,amount,recipient) checks approved extension through the fixed factory, pulls PYUSDx from msg.sender, approves that extension and invokes only wrap(recipient,amount). swapOut(extensionIn,amount,recipient) checks approval, pulls extension tokens from msg.sender, invokes only unwrap(amount), measures actual PYUSDx balance delta and transfers that delta to recipient. No caller-supplied selector, opaque payload or generic external executor exists.

The extension address parameter is NOT pinned to Saturn: every currently factory-approved extension is reachable, including future changes to approval state. This is financial counterparty choice behind a fixed wrap/unwrap interface, not catalog review of every extension implementation. Approved extensions remain external mutable/upgradeable code; factory approval is not financial safety or suitability assurance.

Caller needs preexisting allowance and balance of PYUSDx for swapIn or of the chosen extension for swapOut. Any chosen recipient can differ from caller; no self-only restriction exists. Normal platform templates use six-decimal 1:1 amounts, but facility swapOut transfers actual PYUSDx delta, not an independently guaranteed quote. No min-output, max-input or deadline parameter exists; no funded execution or full acquisition/redemption-to-fiat workflow was exercised.

Facility pause, PYUSDx freeze/compliance controls, chosen extension pause/freeze/whitelist rules and available PYUSDx backing can reject calls. Public platform methods do not confer KYC, jurisdiction, issuer or partner eligibility. Current Saturn example specifically has whitelist enabled and is approved at the observed block; its direct wrap/unwrap methods remain facility-only and are not admitted.

Transient reentrancy lock records msg.sender for a direct caller, or a configured trusted router supplied msgSender for router calls; actual token funding remains from msg.sender. Trusted-router configuration and extension-origin identity are mutable privileged dependencies. No trusted-router configuration, issuer mint/burn, bridge, rewards allocation, signature/permit, role management, generalized swap routing or reserve replacement is admitted.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0

pragma solidity >=0.8.20 <0.9.0;

import { IStatefulERC712 } from "./IStatefulERC712.sol";

/**
 * @title  Transfer via signed authorization following EIP-3009 standard.
 * @author M^0 Labs
 * @dev    The interface as defined by EIP-3009: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3009
 */
interface IERC3009 is IStatefulERC712 {
    /* ============ Events ============ */

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when an authorization has been canceled.
     * @param  authorizer Authorizer's address.
     * @param  nonce      Nonce of the canceled authorization.
     */
    event AuthorizationCanceled(address indexed authorizer, bytes32 indexed nonce);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when an authorization has been used.
     * @param  authorizer Authorizer's address.
     * @param  nonce      Nonce of the used authorization.
     */
    event AuthorizationUsed(address indexed authorizer, bytes32 indexed nonce);

    /* ============ Custom Errors ============ */

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when an authorization has already been used.
     * @param  authorizer Authorizer's address.
     * @param  nonce      Nonce of the used authorization.
     */
    error AuthorizationAlreadyUsed(address authorizer, bytes32 nonce);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when an authorization is expired.
     * @param  timestamp   Timestamp at which the transaction was submitted.
     * @param  validBefore Timestamp before which the authorization would have been valid.
     */
    error AuthorizationExpired(uint256 timestamp, uint256 validBefore);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when an authorization is not yet valid.
     * @param  timestamp  Timestamp at which the transaction was submitted.
     * @param  validAfter Timestamp after which the authorization will be valid.
     */
    error AuthorizationNotYetValid(uint256 timestamp, uint256 validAfter);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the caller of `receiveWithAuthorization` is not the payee.
     * @param  caller Caller's address.
     * @param  payee  Payee's address.
     */
    error CallerMustBePayee(address caller, address payee);

    /* ============ Interactive Functions ============ */

    /**
     * @notice Execute a transfer with a signed authorization.
     * @param  from        Payer's address (Authorizer).
     * @param  to          Payee's address.
     * @param  value       Amount to be transferred.
     * @param  validAfter  The time after which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  validBefore The time before which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  nonce       Unique nonce.
     * @param  signature   A byte array ECDSA/secp256k1 signature (encoded r, s, v).
     */
    function transferWithAuthorization(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 validAfter,
        uint256 validBefore,
        bytes32 nonce,
        bytes memory signature
    ) external;

    /**
     * @notice Execute a transfer with a signed authorization.
     * @param  from        Payer's address (Authorizer).
     * @param  to          Payee's address.
     * @param  value       Amount to be transferred.
     * @param  validAfter  The time after which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  validBefore The time before which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  nonce       Unique nonce.
     * @param  r           An ECDSA/secp256k1 signature parameter.
     * @param  vs          An ECDSA/secp256k1 short signature parameter.
     */
    function transferWithAuthorization(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 validAfter,
        uint256 validBefore,
        bytes32 nonce,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 vs
    ) external;

    /**
     * @notice Execute a transfer with a signed authorization.
     * @param  from        Payer's address (Authorizer).
     * @param  to          Payee's address.
     * @param  value       Amount to be transferred.
     * @param  validAfter  The time after which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  validBefore The time before which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  nonce       Unique nonce.
     * @param  v           v of the signature.
     * @param  r           r of the signature.
     * @param  s           s of the signature.
     */
    function transferWithAuthorization(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 validAfter,
        uint256 validBefore,
        bytes32 nonce,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external;

    /**
     * @notice Receive a transfer with a signed authorization from the payer.
     * @dev    This has an additional check to ensure that the payee's address matches
     *         the caller of this function to prevent front-running attacks.
     *         (See security considerations)
     * @param  from        Payer's address (Authorizer).
     * @param  to          Payee's address.
     * @param  value       Amount to be transferred.
     * @param  validAfter  The time after which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  validBefore The time before which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  nonce       Unique nonce.
     * @param  signature   A byte array ECDSA/secp256k1 signature (encoded r, s, v).
     */
    function receiveWithAuthorization(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 validAfter,
        uint256 validBefore,
        bytes32 nonce,
        bytes memory signature
    ) external;

    /**
     * @notice Receive a transfer with a signed authorization from the payer.
     * @dev    This has an additional check to ensure that the payee's address matches
     *         the caller of this function to prevent front-running attacks.
     *         (See security considerations)
     * @param  from        Payer's address (Authorizer).
     * @param  to          Payee's address.
     * @param  value       Amount to be transferred.
     * @param  validAfter  The time after which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  validBefore The time before which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  nonce       Unique nonce.
     * @param  r           An ECDSA/secp256k1 signature parameter.
     * @param  vs          An ECDSA/secp256k1 short signature parameter.
     */
    function receiveWithAuthorization(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 validAfter,
        uint256 validBefore,
        bytes32 nonce,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 vs
    ) external;

    /**
     * @notice Receive a transfer with a signed authorization from the payer.
     * @dev    This has an additional check to ensure that the payee's address matches
     *         the caller of this function to prevent front-running attacks.
     *         (See security considerations)
     * @param  from        Payer's address (Authorizer).
     * @param  to          Payee's address.
     * @param  value       Amount to be transferred.
     * @param  validAfter  The time after which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  validBefore The time before which this is valid (unix time).
     * @param  nonce       Unique nonce.
     * @param  v           v of the signature.
     * @param  r           r of the signature.
     * @param  s           s of the signature.
     */
    function receiveWithAuthorization(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 validAfter,
        uint256 validBefore,
        bytes32 nonce,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external;

    /**
     * @notice Attempt to cancel an authorization.
     * @param  authorizer Authorizer's address.
     * @param  nonce      Nonce of the authorization.
     * @param  signature  A byte array ECDSA/secp256k1 signature (encoded r, s, v).
     */
    function cancelAuthorization(address authorizer, bytes32 nonce, bytes memory signature) external;

    /**
     * @notice Attempt to cancel an authorization.
     * @param  authorizer Authorizer's address.
     * @param  nonce      Nonce of the authorization.
     * @param  r          An ECDSA/secp256k1 signature parameter.
     * @param  vs         An ECDSA/secp256k1 short signature parameter.
     */
    function cancelAuthorization(address authorizer, bytes32 nonce, bytes32 r, bytes32 vs) external;

    /**
     * @notice Attempt to cancel an authorization.
     * @param  authorizer Authorizer's address.
     * @param  nonce      Nonce of the authorization.
     * @param  v          v of the signature.
     * @param  r          r of the signature.
     * @param  s          s of the signature.
     */
    function cancelAuthorization(address authorizer, bytes32 nonce, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external;

    /* ============ View/Pure Functions ============ */

    /**
     * @notice Returns the state of an authorization.
     * @dev    Nonces are randomly generated 32-byte data unique to the authorizer's address
     * @param  authorizer Authorizer's address.
     * @param  nonce      Nonce of the authorization.
     * @return True if the nonce is used.
     */
    function authorizationState(address authorizer, bytes32 nonce) external view returns (bool);

    /// @notice Returns `transferWithAuthorization` typehash.
    function TRANSFER_WITH_AUTHORIZATION_TYPEHASH() external view returns (bytes32);

    /// @notice Returns `receiveWithAuthorization` typehash.
    function RECEIVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION_TYPEHASH() external view returns (bytes32);

    /// @notice Returns `cancelAuthorization` typehash.
    function CANCEL_AUTHORIZATION_TYPEHASH() external view returns (bytes32);
}

swapIn(extensionOut,amount,recipient) checks approved extension through the fixed factory, pulls PYUSDx from msg.sender, approves that extension and invokes only wrap(recipient,amount). swapOut(extensionIn,amount,recipient) checks approval, pulls extension tokens from msg.sender, invokes only unwrap(amount), measures actual PYUSDx balance delta and transfers that delta to recipient. No caller-supplied selector, opaque payload or generic external executor exists.

The extension address parameter is NOT pinned to Saturn: every currently factory-approved extension is reachable, including future changes to approval state. This is financial counterparty choice behind a fixed wrap/unwrap interface, not catalog review of every extension implementation. Approved extensions remain external mutable/upgradeable code; factory approval is not financial safety or suitability assurance.

Caller needs preexisting allowance and balance of PYUSDx for swapIn or of the chosen extension for swapOut. Any chosen recipient can differ from caller; no self-only restriction exists. Normal platform templates use six-decimal 1:1 amounts, but facility swapOut transfers actual PYUSDx delta, not an independently guaranteed quote. No min-output, max-input or deadline parameter exists; no funded execution or full acquisition/redemption-to-fiat workflow was exercised.

Facility pause, PYUSDx freeze/compliance controls, chosen extension pause/freeze/whitelist rules and available PYUSDx backing can reject calls. Public platform methods do not confer KYC, jurisdiction, issuer or partner eligibility. Current Saturn example specifically has whitelist enabled and is approved at the observed block; its direct wrap/unwrap methods remain facility-only and are not admitted.

Transient reentrancy lock records msg.sender for a direct caller, or a configured trusted router supplied msgSender for router calls; actual token funding remains from msg.sender. Trusted-router configuration and extension-origin identity are mutable privileged dependencies. No trusted-router configuration, issuer mint/burn, bridge, rewards allocation, signature/permit, role management, generalized swap routing or reserve replacement is admitted.
